verdict.rationale: Fellow's MCP Server and 'Ask Fellow' feature explicitly let users ask natural-language questions like "What did we decide in last month's standup?" and pull answers sourced from meeting transcripts/notes across history, with governance controls restricting results to accessible meetings. missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of answer accuracy and explicit confirmation that answers include citation-style sourcing (links to specific meetings) rather than just summarized text.
